comparison.objective: Fit toe-boards along two open platform edges.
comparison.physical_skill: Board alignment and fitting while containing loose balls.
comparison.success_condition: Both edges are protected, no gap exceeds 6 mm, and balls do not roll off.
comparison.reason: Edge guarding and loss prevention are unrelated to damper adjustment and impact-response commissioning. The record body and all specs are absent, but its title states a clearly different objective and success criterion.
